notes: Owner 2026-10-04: use 70-80% of the week's allowance; daytime (before 17:00 UK) stays light because the owner uses Claude at work; after 17:00 UK each 5-hour session may be run to its limit. The owner reports usage with a Telegram note like `usage 62% fable 71%`; any routine that reads it updates `report` here. The weekly allowance resets Thursday 03:00 UTC. `npm run slots` (2026-10-14, foundry slot-utilisation-report) asks for a fresh note through the Monday report's digest line when `report.date` is older than 7 days, once per 7 days. While `report.date` is older than 7 days the burn-down paces itself (2026-10-24, foundry burn-pace-stale-usage-report): Monday and Tuesday nights stop after three slots that found work, and any night stops on a usage-limit signal of the last 24 h (`npm run pipeline cold` prints `paced: …`). Week budget (2026-10-29, foundry burn-weekly-slot-budget): while the report is stale the whole week is paced too — the capacity is the working slots (distinct build/burn-down hours in docs/RUNS.md) the previous week ran before its first `usage limit?` watchdog line (W44: 33 between Thursday 10-22 03:00 and the stalled 10-27 17:00 build), else `week_slots` here; `week_reserve` slots stay for Wednesday (the 08:00 exchange and two builds), the rest is spent from the Thursday 03:00 reset, and every Thursday-to-Tuesday night runs at most its share of what the two daily build slots leave (33 → 3 burn-down slots a night). Wednesday night keeps no nightly cap.
